evidence_items.source_title: What Betfair Exchange market data is available from listMarketBook / Stream API? - Betfair Developer Program
evidence_items.claim_summary: The Exchange API returns Betfair's own exchange market data (back/lay prices, last traded price, traded volume).
evidence_items.excerpt: The screenshot shows the equivalent data on the Betfair Exchange website.
evidence_items.notes: Operator-level, but a single exchange operator (Betfair).

evidence_items.source_title: What Betfair Exchange market data is available from listMarketBook / Stream API? - Betfair Developer Program
evidence_items.claim_summary: The source exposes only Betfair's own exchange prices (a single exchange operator), not a multi-bookmaker comparison feed; there is exactly one quoted operator.
evidence_items.notes: Provider identity (Betfair) equals the single operator identity; governed multi-operator Consensus/SpotBoard requires several distinct operators (DEC-013).

evidence_items.source_title: What Betfair Exchange market data is available from listMarketBook / Stream API? - Betfair Developer Program
evidence_items.claim_summary: The quoted operator is unambiguously Betfair (a single exchange).

evidence_items.claim_summary: The accessible support pages document market-data content and identifiers but not data-use rights, selection identifiers, timestamps, or request limits; deeper API reference pages were not retrievable this sprint.
